sections.title: Who should I call?
sections.text:
Who should I call? 
 🐦 Birds & land wildlife 831-264-5427 SPCA Monterey County 
 🦭 Seals & sea lions 415-289-7325 Marine Mammal Center 
 🦦 Sea otters · Monterey County 831-648-4840 Monterey Bay Aquarium 
 🐋 Entangled whales 877-767-9425 NOAA SOS-WHAL 
 Tap a number to call. Do not attempt disentanglement. If the species is uncertain, describe the animal to the responder.

sections.title: 🧭 What to say when you call
sections.text: 🧭 What to say when you call “I'm reporting a possibly injured or distressed animal.” Where:  exact location, nearby landmark or GPS. What:  animal type, approximate size and how many. Condition:  alive/dead, injury, abnormal behavior, entanglement, oil or fishing gear. When:  time last observed and direction of travel if moving. How to reach you:  name and callback number. Photos/video can help  only if taken without approaching or disturbing  the animal. Follow responder directions.

sections.title: 🐦 Seabirds & wildlife — SPCA
sections.text: 🐦 Seabirds & wildlife — SPCA SPCA Wildlife Rescue & Rehabilitation 📞 831-264-5427 Injured, sick or orphaned birds and land animals in Monterey County. Call before touching or moving wildlife. Location:  1002 Monterey-Salinas Highway, Salinas, CA 93908. Hours:  seasonal; September–March generally 8 AM–5 PM; April–August generally 7 AM–7 PM. Confirm when calling. SPCA species-specific instructions ↗

sections.title: 🦭 Seals & sea lions — symptoms & response
sections.text: 🦭 Seals & sea lions — symptoms & response The Marine Mammal Center 📞 415-289-7325 Report obviously injured, stranded or ill pinnipeds.  Do not approach or handle.  A resting seal on a beach is not necessarily stranded. Warning signs in the July Naturalist Field Note Excessive drooling or foaming, seizures, side-to-side head motion, disorientation, and unusual upward/backward head posture (“stargazing”). These warrant a call; do not diagnose from appearance alone. Keep observers and dogs well back. NOAA's stranding safety guidance says to maintain at least 100 yards when possible.

sections.title: 🦦 Sea otters — Monterey County
sections.text: 🦦 Sea otters — Monterey County Monterey Bay Aquarium Sea Otter Hotline 📞 831-648-4840 Report apparently abandoned pups, injured, ill or deceased sea otters in  Monterey County . Stay at least 50 feet away; do not touch, feed or attempt capture. Note exact location and behavior. Elsewhere:  Santa Cruz County and north, or San Luis Obispo County and south — Marine Mammal Center  415-289-7325  for live distressed otters. Dead otters outside Monterey County may be routed to CDFW. MBA stranded sea otter guidance ↗

sections.title: 🐋 Whales, dolphins & entanglement
sections.text: 🐋 Whales, dolphins & entanglement NOAA Fisheries Entangled whale: 📞 877-767-9425 (SOS-WHAL) Stranded, injured or deceased marine mammal: 📞 866-767-6114 Keep at least 100 yards from whales. Never cut lines or attempt disentanglement. If on a vessel, U.S. Coast Guard VHF Channel 16 is another way to report an entangled whale. NOAA response guidance ↗

sections.title: ⚠️ Oiled wildlife or suspected rabies
sections.text: ⚠️ Oiled wildlife or suspected rabies Oiled wildlife 📞 877-823-6926 · Oiled Wildlife Care Network Do not attempt to clean an oiled animal yourself. Wild animal suspected of rabies Do not handle. For a living animal, call  SPCA Wildlife Center 831-264-5427 . If the animal contacted a pet or is deceased, Monterey County Animal Services:  831-769-8850 .

sections.title: 📍 Additional local contacts & situations
sections.text: 📍 Additional local contacts & situations Deceased whale, dolphin, seal, sea lion or turtle — Monterey County south of Pajaro River:  Moss Landing Marine Laboratories  831-771-4422 . Confirm routing with a wildlife responder if unsure. Dead seabirds:  NOAA advises leaving them in place on sanctuary beaches unless instructed otherwise; report unusual mortality events or suspected oil contamination. Roadside deceased animals:  Monterey County Public Works  831-755-4800 .
